description: Source code for OvsAgent API implementation, including initialization, configuration management, database interaction, and callback handling for OVS database operations.

classes.name: ovs_agent_api_context
classes.description: Context structure holding component ID, synchronization primitives, and state flags for API operations.

methods.name: signal_callback_completion
methods.description: Signals condition variable to indicate completion of an operation.

methods.name: delete_table_entries
methods.description: Deletes entries from Gateway_Config and Feedback tables in OVS database using a request UUID.

methods.name: wait_for_callback_completion
methods.description: Waits for callback completion or timeout, managing synchronization and status reporting.

methods.name: ovs_agent_api_monitor_feedback_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving feedback monitor updates, processes transaction completion and cleanup.

methods.name: send_monitor_feedback_request
methods.description: Initiates monitor request for Feedback table in OVS database.

methods.name: send_monitor_feedback_cancel_request
methods.description: Cancels monitor request for Feedback table in OVS database.

methods.name: ovs_agent_api_write_callback
methods.description: Handles write operation callbacks, updates transactions, and triggers feedback monitor if needed.

methods.name: component_id_enum_to_string
methods.description: Converts component ID enum to string representation.

methods.name: ovs_agent_api_init
methods.description: Initializes the OvsAgent API context, database connection, logging, and transaction manager.

methods.name: ovs_agent_api_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the API context, database connection, logging, and transaction manager.

methods.name: print_gateway_config
methods.description: Prints details of Gateway_Config structure for debugging.

methods.name: print_feedback_config
methods.description: Prints details of Feedback structure for debugging.

methods.name: print_rdkb_table_config
methods.description: Prints details of Rdkb_Table_Config structure, including specific config types.

methods.name: handle_transact_insert_request
methods.description: Handles transaction-based insert requests to OVS database, managing blocking and callbacks.

methods.name: handle_monitor_insert_request
methods.description: Handles monitor requests to OVS database for specific tables.

methods.name: ovs_agent_api_interact
methods.description: Main entry point for OVS database interactions, supporting insert and monitor operations.

methods.name: initialize_gateway_config
methods.description: Initializes Gateway_Config structure with default values.

methods.name: ovs_agent_api_get_config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration structures for specified OVS tables.
